blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Сдались, — уронил он сквозь ___ (ус, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **ус → усы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural усы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  Declension: sg. ус · уса · усу · ус · усом · усе; pl. усы · усов · усам · усы · усами · усах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Толпа, хлынувшая через ___ (мост, acc. sg.), приближалась к зданию казарм.
exercises.why: **мост → мост** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. мост · моста · мосту · мост · мостом · мосте; pl. мосты · мостов · мостам · мосты · мостами · мостах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Никто и не узнает про ___ (наша любовь, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **любовь → любовь** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **наш → нашу** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with любовь). A possessive — declines like DLI's наш. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. любовь · любви · любви · любовь · любовью · любви; pl. любви · любвей · любвям · любви · любвями · любвях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сквозь ___ (тишина, acc. sg.), как сквозь сон, пробивались бессвязные звуки, бредил город.
exercises.why: **тишина → тишину** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. тишина · тишины · тишине · тишину · тишиной · тишине; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Карташев повел Корнева окружным путем — через ___ (целый ряд, acc. sg.) комнат.
exercises.why: **ряд → ряд** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **целый → целый** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with ряд). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. ряд · ряда · ряду · ряд · рядом · ряде; pl. ряды · рядов · рядам · ряды · рядами · рядах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он не только про ___ (махновец, acc. pl.) говорил.
exercises.why: **махновец → махновцев** (acc. pl.). Masculine, animate; nominative plural махновцы. Declines like DLI's студент — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. студентов). Ending — (no ending) → -ев, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: махновц- + -ев.  Declension: sg. махновец · махновца · махновцу · махновца · махновцем · махновце; pl. махновцы · махновцев · махновцам · махновцев · махновцами · махновцах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сквозь ___ (разбитое окно, acc. sg.) виден был пожар.
exercises.why: **окно → окно** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **разбитый → разбитое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with окно). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новое. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. окно · окна · окну · окно · окном · окне; pl. окна · окон · окнам · окна · окнами · окнах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Палтусов ввел Марью Орестовну из коридора-галереи через ___ (вторая гостиная, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **гостиная → гостиную** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. A noun that declines like an adjective (an adjective used as a noun): it takes adjective endings, not noun endings. Ending -ая → -ую.  **второй → вторую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with гостиную). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. гостиная · гостиной · гостиной · гостиную · гостиной · гостиной; pl. гостиные · гостиных · гостиным · гостиные · гостиными · гостиных.  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты бы уж лучше про ___ (девочка, acc. pl.) рассказывал, Теплов.
exercises.why: **девочка → девочек** (acc. pl.). Feminine, animate; nominative plural девочки. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты), except the accusative, which follows the animacy rule. Ending -а → — (no ending; -е- is inserted before the final к: девочек).  Declension: sg. девочка · девочки · девочке · девочку · девочкой · девочке; pl. девочки · девочек · девочкам · девочек · девочками · девочках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **мой → мое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with плечо). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative. Ending — (no ending) → -а.  **ваш → вашего** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with ловкача). A possessive — declines like DLI's наш. Ending — (no ending) → -его.  Declension: sg. ловкач · ловкача · ловкачу · ловкача · ловкачом · ловкаче; pl. ловкачи · ловкачей · ловкачам · ловкачей · ловкачами · ловкачах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. exercises.q: Сквозь ___ (автоматическая оболочка, acc. sg.) порой, однако, прорывается что-то из другой жизни.
exercises.why: **оболочка → оболочку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **автоматический → автоматическую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with оболочку). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. оболочка · оболочки · оболочке · оболочку · оболочкой · оболочке; pl. оболочки · оболочек · оболочкам · оболочки · оболочками · оболочках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47. exercises.why: **роща → рощу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. роща · рощи · роще · рощу · рощей · роще; pl. рощи · рощ · рощам · рощи · рощами · рощах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. exercises.q: М-кий воодушевлялся, только вспоминая про ___ (своя мать, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **мать → мать** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → свою** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with мать). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. мать · матери · матери · мать · матерью · матери; pl. матери · матерей · матерям · матерей · матерями · матерях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «The nouns мать and дочь take -ер- before the ending in all cases except the nom. and the acc. sing.: матерью, дочерью.» — DLI, Lesson 30.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
